symptom: A search performed on the live VII site did not appear in the authenticated /admin/search-pages work queue, whose live dashboard showed zero recorded searches and zero pending opportunities.
expected_behavior: A consented public search in every supported commercial world creates or updates an editable search-page opportunity; an authenticated administrator test search remains visible in a clearly separate test lane without contributing to public demand metrics.
environment: VII production Site version 412 at https://vii.spaplus.co on 2026-10-14, authenticated administrator session, /admin/search-pages.

steps: Open the live authenticated /admin/search-pages route after performing a public-site search.
Observe the 30-day search metrics and the active work queue.
reproduction.evidence: The live route displayed 0 searches, 0 unique visitors and 0 pending opportunities while listing only 22 seeded published pages.

observations.observation: Detailed result tracking was wired only in the events result route.
observations.evidence: Repository search before the fix found trackSearchResults in app/events/search/page.tsx but not in vacation, spa or hourly result components.

observations.observation: Authenticated administrator search demand was stored as internal and then stopped before opportunity creation.
observations.evidence: saveSearchEvent returned on `!inserted || internal` immediately before the opportunity upsert.

observations.observation: The production opportunity database and admin read path were available.
observations.evidence: The live authenticated dashboard successfully returned and rendered 22 managed published opportunities rather than an availability error.

hypotheses.mechanism: Vacation, spa and hourly result pages never send the detailed event required to create an opportunity.
hypotheses.prediction: Only the events result page imports and calls trackSearchResults.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Search all public result-family source files for trackSearchResults.
hypotheses.result: The call existed only in the events result page before the repair.

hypotheses.mechanism: Administrator searches are deliberately excluded before the opportunity upsert.
hypotheses.prediction: An internal detailed event is inserted into demand storage but produces no opportunity row.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Inspect the save boundary and exercise it against an in-memory migrated database.
hypotheses.result: The pre-fix branch returned when internal was true; the new regression fixture proves the repaired path retains an internal opportunity with public count zero.

hypotheses.mechanism: The production database or authenticated admin API is unavailable.
hypotheses.prediction: The live page would show an availability error and fail to load seeded managed opportunities.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Open the authenticated live dashboard and inspect its returned inventory.
hypotheses.result: The dashboard loaded 22 managed opportunities successfully, so the database and admin read path were available.

fix.change: Emit detailed search-result events from vacation, events, spa and hourly families, and upsert administrator searches as separate internal-test opportunities while keeping all public metrics filtered to internal=0.
fix.evidence: Focused search analytics, opportunity studio and command-center tests pass, including a migrated in-memory internal-search fixture and static coverage for all four worlds.

regression_checks.check: Detailed demand event validation and opportunity idempotency
Administrator search stays separate from public demand
regression_checks.evidence: In-memory fixture stored internal=1, created the opportunity, kept search_count at 0 and retained result count.

regression_checks.check: All four commercial result families call trackSearchResults
regression_checks.evidence: Static family coverage test passed for vacation, events, spa and hourly.

remaining_unknowns: The exact consent state and exact search world used in Adir's original browser action were not directly observable; demand tracking continues to require measurement consent.
Production proof remains pending until the repaired commit is deployed and a fresh consented administrator test search is observed in the internal-test lane.
authorization_boundary: Read-only production diagnosis, in-scope local repair and previously authorized VII publication; no supplier pull, catalog mutation, permission change or destructive action.
